focus: future-facing uptake can change because beneficiaries were narrowed to one's own children or grandchildren or because caregiver identity changed household constraints, rather than because universal future regard strengthened
intergenerational cooperation can change because dialogue became youth-led or reciprocal and because sustained contact reduced ageism, rather than because the underlying reciprocity policy improved
implementor_warning: Do not treat descendant-linked or dialogue-mediated gains as generic Golden-Rule progress until the world publishes beneficiary kinship scope, caregiver-role activation, voice symmetry, and influence direction semantics.
